# Emil Kowalski — vendor hub

This vendor has no single master skill; it ships 9 tools, each a command of its own.
`/design-tools:emil <tool> <target>` runs that tool; `/design-tools:emil` alone lists them.

**Request:** $ARGUMENTS

## Do

- If the request starts with one of the tool names below, run it exactly as its own command would
  (`commands/<command>.md`): resolve with `bash "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/resolve.sh" <tool>`,
  load (`load: skill` → Skill tool; `load: read` → Read and follow, base first), brand contract before
  any write, run, report what changed. Read-only tools change nothing.
- If it names none of them, print the list below with one line each and ask which one — do not guess,
  and do not run two.

## Tools

- `/design-tools:emil-design-eng` — Polishes how a component feels: springs, interruptibility, the invisible details — Emil Kowalski's bar. (writes)
- `/design-tools:emil-apple-design` — Direct-manipulation motion: drag, swipe, sheets, velocity handoff, momentum, interruptibility. (writes)
- `/design-tools:emil-find-animation-opportunities` — Read-only: finds where motion is missing but earned, and proposes it. (read-only)
- `/design-tools:emil-improve-animations` — Read-only: audits all existing motion and writes a plan for other agents. (read-only)
- `/design-tools:emil-review-animations` — Read-only review of animation code against Emil's craft bar; defaults to flagging. (read-only)
- `/design-tools:emil-animation-vocabulary` — Reverse dictionary: describe an effect, get its name and a reference. (read-only)
- `/design-tools:emil-pick-ui-library` — Recommends a UI component library for your stack. (read-only)
- `/design-tools:emil-ask-sonner` — Answers questions about the Sonner toast library. (read-only)
- `/design-tools:emil-prototype` — Builds several genuinely different versions of one UI piece behind a live picker; promote the winner. (writes)

Vendor card: `wiki/vendors/emil.md` · vendor contract: Taste questions go here; performance questions go to ibelick. `prototype` and `review-animations` are `disable-model-invocation` — they only run when named.
